mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the same month are not statistically different from the prior month's returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the 5-day return is positive despite the rate spike.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +0.5% in a month, it signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting investors to demand higher equity compensation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the CPI acceleration, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a two-sample test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS (labor market additions) of at least 50,000 jobs over three consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which reduces recession risk and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly average over last 3 months > 50,000
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns over the next quarter are negative or the 3-month moving average of job additions turns negative before the return window.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of GDPC1 (real private consumption) to INDPRO (industrial production) exceeds 1.10 for two consecutive months, it indicates robust consumer demand relative to supply capacity, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) in a rolling window, or the ratio reverts below 1.10 within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 4.0% for three consecutive months suggests tighter labor market conditions and reduces discounting of future earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in the same horizon, or the decline in UNRATE reverses before the return window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls by more than 2.0% in a month relative to the prior month, it indicates softening industrial production capacity, which raises uncertainty and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05), or INDPRO recovers by more than 2.0% within the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS below 4.00% and RSAFS (reserves) growing by at least 5% month-over-month, investors anticipate continued accommodative policy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are flat or negative, or policy signals shift (FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% and RSAFS growth stalls).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in HOUST (housing starts) by at least 10% in a month coincides with rising uncertainty about the housing recovery and tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05), or HOUST recovers by >10% within the same month.
